name: c-call-depth
description: Visualize C call depth, worst-case stack usage (-fstack-usage), and the call graph inline — built for embedded/firmware and DO-178C / ISO 26262 stack-usage review.

cCallDepth.suDirectory.description: Directory to scan recursively for .su files (produced by gcc/clang -fstack-usage). Relative paths resolve against the workspace root. Empty disables stack-usage analysis. Typical values: "build", "out", "_build".

cCallDepth.rootPatterns.description: Glob patterns for header (.h) files whose declared functions become 'pinned roots' — treated as depth=1 entry points regardless of who calls them. Use to declare module boundaries, e.g. ["**/public/**", "**/api/**"].

enumDescriptions: Colored pill at end of the function-name line (severity-coded by peak stack).
Show info only when the cursor hovers over a function name.
cCallDepth.displayMode.description: How call-depth and stack info is shown next to function definitions.

cCallDepth.stackThresholds.warn.description: Peak-stack bytes below or equal to this render green; above renders yellow.

cCallDepth.stackThresholds.critical.description: Peak-stack bytes above this render red.

cCallDepth.maxDepthForCumulative.description: Safety limit for cumulative stack traversal in case of unbroken recursion.

cCallDepth.pathsLimit.description: Max paths shown per direction (outgoing/incoming) in hover popups and side panel.

cCallDepth.pathsMaxDepth.description: Maximum depth when enumerating callee/caller chains.

cCallDepth.fpOverridesPath.description: Path to a JSON file of call-site function-pointer overrides for manual verification/narrowing. Format: {"overrides":[{"caller":"fn","file":"src.c","line":42,"targets":["a","b"]}]}. Empty = use <workspace>/fp-overrides.json if present.

enumDescriptions: Verbose: per-entry .su match details, per-poll LSP counts.
cCallDepth.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the C Call Depth output channel.

cCallDepth.pythonPath.description: Python 3 interpreter used for the 'python-cli' backend.

cCallDepth.libclangPath.description: Path to libclang.so/.dylib/.dll for the 'python-cli' backend — either the library file itself or the directory containing it. On Windows, pointing at the directory lets the loader find libclang.dll's sibling DLLs. Leave empty to auto-detect (the pip 'libclang' package ships one). Only used by the python-cli backend.

cCallDepth.clangArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to libclang when parsing, e.g. ["-DUNIT_TEST=1", "-isystem/opt/toolchain/include"]. compile_commands.json flags are used automatically; these are added on top. Use -isystem/-I here if your compile_commands.json lacks needed include paths.

cCallDepth.compileCommandsDir.description: Path to compile_commands.json, or the directory containing it, for the 'python-cli' backend (relative to the workspace or absolute). Defaults to the workspace root, then a 'build' subdir. The backend analyzes exactly the translation units listed there.
